name: HAWK
recent: Steel Hawk 于 9 月 30 日完成对 Sparksfly O&G 的股份认购，并在 8 月底签署两份谅解备忘录。同期多名董事及委员会成员变动，包括执行董事 Salimi Khairuddin 于 9 月 15 日辞任。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比增 50.3%，但净亏损 941 万令吉。
notable: 完成对 Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd 的股份认购。
签署两份谅解备忘录（2026 年 8 月 28 日公告）。
执行董事 Salimi Khairuddin 于 9 月 15 日辞任。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 941 万令吉，亏损同比扩大。
董事及委员会成员近期出现多项变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 1,771.5 万令吉，同比增 50.3%，环比降 14.5%；净亏损 940.8 万令吉，净利率 -53.1%，去年同期净利率为 9.8%。

recent_en: Steel Hawk completed the subscription of shares in Sparksfly O&G on 30 September and signed two memoranda of understanding in late August. Several board and committee changes occurred during the period, including the resignation of Executive Director Salimi Khairuddin on 15 September. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 50.3% year-on-year but the company recorded a net loss of RM9.41 million.
notable_en: Completed the subscription of shares in Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd.
Signed two memoranda of understanding (announced on 28 August 2026).
Executive Director Salimi Khairuddin resigned on 15 September.
risks_en: Latest quarter net loss was RM9.41 million, with losses widening year-on-year.
Several board and committee changes occurred recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM17.715 million, up 50.3% year-on-year but down 14.5% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM9.408 million with a net margin of -53.1%, compared with a net margin of 9.8% a year earlier.
